SRC-177:R001.text: Repair SAIPEN validator semantics so reproduction (reproduced=y) and finding disposition (ACCIDENTAL_SUCCESS) are treated as orthogonal facts: preserve the invariant that a CONFIRMED swept finding naming a ticket must carry actual reproduction evidence, and remove the invariant that ACCIDENTAL_SUCCESS categorically implies reproduced != y -- without editing the completed SWEEP, rewriting the immutable improve report, flipping reproduced=y, or adding any project-level workaround
